programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective
programme.desc: All the toys in Toyland are visiting Fuse's workshop for a toy check but something is wrong! Toys are fine before the check and wonky after! Noddy investigates why toys are going wonky so that he can help them return to normal quickly. With the help of his wwwbook and following all the clues Noddy works out that Fuse has given himself a robot upgrade to help him do the toy checks quickly but he installed it incorrectly. That's why he's been making the toys go wonky! Noddy helps Fuse uninstall the upgrade and soon everyone is back to normal. Well done Noddy!

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service
programme.desc: It's Chris Beacon's birthday and he's looking forward to spending the day onshore and having a party at the village hall. Pat's SDS mission is to pick up all the presents from everyone who won't be able to be at the party later. The kids and Lauren are working on decorating the village hall and making Ben a big card from them all whilst Nisha and Ajay provide special birthday cakes for Chris and Micawber and Alf and Dorothy send over lovely fresh eggs and cheese and a special homemade woolly jumper. Meanwhile, the weather is getting worse out at Pencaster Lighthouse and Chris realises, sadly, that he'll have to stay and man the lighthouse and make sure that the passing boats are protected. He won't be able to join everyone for his birthday after all! But Pat has a great idea – if Chris can't come to the birthday party, the birthday party can come to him! programme.desc: Yoshida Ryusei, an October matsuri, features rockets called ryusei that are made by local teams and carry community prayers high in the sky. Team members pour heart and soul into their efforts.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Lunch On!
programme.desc: We visit the Echizen Matsushima Aquarium, where, for some reason, many staff members eat instant noodles for lunch. Join us as we explore the work they do and the reason behind the instant noodles.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Asia Insight
programme.desc: An increasing number of young people are relocating to Jingdezhen, the porcelain capital of China. They leave behind the stress of life in large cities to resculpt their own lives with a new vision.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Iwata's Grandma
programme.desc: Why does Iwata's Grandma refuse to be in photos? This animation documentary is based on a picture book about the atomic bomb tragedy but conveys kindness and hope rather than fear and anxiety.

programme.desc: Two police informants assume tough personas to con money from small-time criminals. But all their wise-cracking pretense traps them to be part of a crime boss's major operations.

programme.title: Brush ep 4
programme.desc: Alex becomes a famous makeup artist because of her mother’s unique brush set but will face a challenge when all her clients begin to die, one by one.

programme.title: Encounter ep 24
programme.desc: A story of two strangers meeting at the most unlikely place and sharing an important moment, not knowing that they will be soon be brought togetheragain by fatte, fall in love, and challenged by the very different worlds they live in.

programme.title: Kurdapya ep 5
programme.desc: Kurdapya tells the story of long-lost twins, KURING \u0026 DAPHNE. They meet after a strange accident and discover that they lead extremely different lives. Kuring grew up with the cruel extended family in the province while Daphne is an undervalued publishing executive in the city. Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

programme.title: Da Pers Family ep 10
programme.desc:
A story of a couple who preserves the family 
bakery business legacy from closure. Now the 
couple’s children, volunteers to step in and help the 
business. Are the parents willing to accept change

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sang pelatih Velociraptor dan manajer operasional Jurassic World harus menyelamatkan para turis dari seekor dinosaurus hibrida berbahaya yang kabur sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: Jurassic World Rebirth: New Era
programme.desc: Tayangan ini akan mengajak Anda melihat langsung aksi di balik layar. Para bintang dan sineas akan membawa Anda dari Thailand ke Malta untuk melihat aksi dan dinosaurus yang belum pernah dilihat sebelumnya.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Sebuah prekuel yang berfokus pada kisah pertemuan James T. Kirk muda dan Tn. Spock di Akademi Starfleet beserta misi luar angkasa pertama mereka.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: Pada tahun 2154, orang kaya menghuni sebuah stasiun ruang angkasa dan orang miskin tinggal di planet Bumi. Seorang pria menjalankan misi untuk membawa kesetaraan bagi dunia nan bertolak belakang tersebut.

programme.title: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1872, seorang penemu asal Inggris, pencuri asal Tiongkok, dan seniman asal Prancis berkeliling dunia dalam waktu 80 hari via jalur darat, udara, dan laut menggunakan sepatu roda untuk mencapai tujuan mereka.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: Will dan Jake Grimm menyamar sebagai pengusir setan yang selalu berpindah tempat. Mereka lalu mendapati sebuah kutukan dunia dongeng yang menuntut keberanian sejati, bukan ritual palsu yang biasa mereka lakukan.

programme.title: The One
programme.desc: Semesta paralel berbenturan ketika seorang agen pemberontak yang ditugaskan untuk mengawasi dunia alternatif mulai memusnahkan kepribadiannya yang lain untuk menjadi The One.

programme.title: The Legend Of Zorro
programme.desc: Sang pahlawan bertopeng nan gagah berani melakukan misi paling berbahaya sepanjang hidupnya.

programme.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure
programme.desc: Dua bersaudara terjebak dalam sebuah petualangan antargalaksi saat rumah mereka terhempas secara ajaib ke ruang angkasa.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Alice wakes up to find that Raccoon city is infested with zombies and monsters. Later, she tries her best to find a way out of the city before it is too late.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Callum Lynch learns of his ancestor Aguilar de Nerha's ties to a brotherhood of dangerous assassins. So, he travels back in time to acquire their skills and take down a corrupt organisation.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen leads a lonely life and is bullied by his peers at school. He happily befriends Abby, his new helpful neighbour, without being aware that she is hiding a secret from him.

programme.title: Vehicle 19
programme.desc: Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.

programme.title: DSC
programme.desc: Talented directors provide an entertaining insight into the most intriguing stories and anecdotes concerning some of their best works.

programme.title: The Gold Rush
programme.desc: During the Klondike Gold Rush, a lone prospector goes through a series of misfortunes, including a blizzard and starvation. However, he finds love even in the stormy Alaska.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: Imprisoned at the International Space Station, a group of terrorists manage to escape confinement and take control of the ship. However, their mission to target the Soviets threatens world peace.

programme.title: I Am Wrath
programme.desc: After corrupt cops are unable to catch his wife's killers, Stanley, an unemployed man, teams up with an old friend to avenge her death.

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: A US air marshal receives threatening messages demanding that his airline transfer USD 150 million dollars to an offshore account, in the absence of which the passengers of his flight will be killed.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky, the reigning world champion, accepts a boxing challenge from Clubber Lang and loses the match. He also ends up losing his credibility as a champion, and has to fight to get it back.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie
programme.desc: Emmet, an ordinary individual prophesied to be the Special, is entrusted with the responsibility of saving the Lego world from the cruel ways of Lord Business.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: When in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, Max, a wanderer, joins the rebel warrior Imperator Furiosa against his will in order to dethrone an autocrat who controls water supply to the land.

programme.title: Alien vs. Predator
programme.desc: The archaeology team from Weyland Industries finds itself trapped between two alien species.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: James Bond reaches the North Korean military base and finds out the presence of a corrupt colonel. However, his identity is revealed, and he strives to escape and reprimand the criminals.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: After Paris, a Trojan prince, has an affair with Menelaus's wife, Helen, he decides to take her with him. Later, Menelaus's brother uses that as an excuse to wage a war against the city of Troy.

programme.title: Wonder Woman
programme.desc: Princess Diana of an all-female Amazonian race rescues US pilot Steve. Upon learning of a war, she ventures into the world of men to stop Ares, the god of war, from destroying mankind.
